---
title: "03 - Augment Data"
format: html
---

## Library Loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


## Data Loading
```{r}
## Load Data
mortality_clean <- read_tsv(file = here("data/02_dat_mortality.tsv"))
measles_clean <- read_tsv(file = here("data/02_dat_measles.tsv"))
stunting_clean <- read_tsv(file = here("data/02_dat_stunting.tsv"))
```


## Inner Join
### The tables are joined together, keeping only the rows where the ISO3 code and the year variable match across all datasets.
```{r}
## Inner Join
dat_joined_inner <- mortality_clean |>
  inner_join(
    measles_clean |> select(-country, -region),
    by = c("country_code", "year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    stunting_clean |> select(-country, -region),
    by = c("country_code", "year")
  )
```


## Left Join
### Every row from the measles table is kept; mortality and stunting data are attached where a matching ISO3 code / year pair exists.
```{r}
dat_joined_left <- measles_clean |>
  left_join(
    mortality_clean |> select(-country, -region),
    by = c("country_code", "year")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    stunting_clean |> select(-country, -region),
    by = c("country_code", "year")
  )
```


## Store Augment Data
```{r}
write_tsv(x = dat_joined_inner, file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = dat_joined_left, file = here("data/03_dat_aug_left.tsv"))
```
